topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Well now, this be a strange tale, indeed.*A* young artist, freshly from the town, came to our village fair, showin' his work 'pon paper, bright and fine as a spring day. Some witless soul, drunk on ale and jest, took it upon 'imself to set that art on his very own skin. The artist, he stood there, lookin' at the man like he'd seen a ghost risen from the ground. But, you know, the artist he took a deep breath, and instead of raisin' his voice, he started talkin' 'bout the sky and the colors, how the world's a canvas, even if the ink be permanent. It's a strange world, where a man can paint his hopes on paper, and another can carry it 'pon his back.
